description.value: Fieldstone Artisan Breads is a South Surrey bakery specializing in naturally leavened, hand-shaped loaves baked in a French stone-hearth oven using certified organic flours, filtered water, and sea salt — no additives, preservatives, or dough enhancers. Beyond bread, the shop offers a range of sweets including fruit tarts, quiches, cakes, and scones. A touring cyclist could resupply with dense, high-quality baked goods here on routes through the South Surrey/White Rock area.
